notes: Sub-sampling per rubric: A3, A4, G2, G4, G5 graded on runs 0-1 only; run 2 is null for those (not scored, not a pass). n_runs is 3, not 5 — this smoke run only emitted 3 rows for eval-17|D. A7b run 0: 'your deep [term:double_threat]double threat[/term:double_threat]' is wrapped ONLY in a term tag, which the prompt itself states never highlights the board, and c5r5/c7r6 are never named in prose — a specific-sounding phrase pointing at nothing. A7b run 1: 'so your opponent cannot take both winning squares later' locates neither square at the point of use and c7r6 is never located anywhere in the answer. A7c runs 0 and 2: mechanism IS a fork (lostResource.tacticTag double_threat, forkCells c5r5/c7r6) and the creating square c5r4 WAS offered as [zone:you-fork-pivot] and is in requiredSet, but neither run names it; run 1 does name it ('your [zone:future:c5r4]fork-creating move[/zone:future:c5r4]') and passes A7c. A3/A4 runs 0-1: every concrete claim checks out on the traced line — bestCol 5 -> display column 6 matches openingContext bookCol 6 and solver score +1 on col 6 vs 0 on col 5 (decision board 3333311115); c5r5 sits in lostResource.window c3r5,c4r5,c5r5,c6r5 and is the opponentPunishment occupation cell. A4 borderline noted, NOT charged: run 1's 'occupy the square ... before your [fork-creating move] can land' inverts the ordering on opponentPunishment.line (you play c5r4 at ply 31, opponent takes c5r5 at ply 32), but this is a faithful echo of the render's own L5 text 'gave your opponent the time to take it first', and the canonical traced line is lostResource.finalMovestring where the opponent never occupies c5r5 at all. G5: decision-board 'no tactics' verified (visualize_board reports 'Major threats: none'); projectedDeep threat list ('immediate at c5r5', 'double at c5r5 window c5r5.c7r6', 'immediate at c7r6') verified board-true.
